product_metadata.title: ThinkGeek Radioactive Elements Glowing Coaster Set - Radium, Plutonium, Uranium, and Thorium - Set of 4
features: BRING THE ELEMENTS TO LIFE: Throwing a great party isn't an exact science, but adding these exclusive science-themed coasters will certainly help balance the equation. Perfect for anyone who enjoys a bit of chemistry in their decor.

PERFECT FOR YOUR PERIODIC TABLE: Each of these light-up coasters feature a radioactive element with all of its associated table information. These coasters add a bit of elemental flair to your coffee table and furniture.

RADIOACTIVE BY NATURE, DURABLE BY DESIGN: Remarkably stable and protective of your furniture, these plastic coasters light up when you place your drinks on them. Powerful display operates via eight 3V CR2032 batteries (included).

WHAT'S INCLUDED: The complete set includes four plastic coasters, each measuring 4 x 4 inches. A suitable size to fit a variety of drinkware around the lab, including assorted mugs, tumblers, glasses, beakers, and more.

ESSENTIAL FOR SCIENCE ENTHUSIASTS: For students, teachers, and scientific hobbyists, this coaster set is more than a simple drink holder. These coasters make a wonderful collectible piece that will get a great reaction in any scientist's home.
description: IT'S A GREAT SOLUTION TO MESSY WATER RINGS When you want to keep your tabletop almost as clean as the lab, these exclusive light-up drink coasters are the solution. The set of four durable plastic coasters feature the symbols of Radium-226, Plutonium-244, Uranium-238, and Thorium-232, so you can share a drink with a group of buddies and not have to worry about the cross contamination. Add some science to your bar, living room, or kitchen with these periodically cool drink coasters. YOU CAN NEVER TRUST AN ATOM. THEY MAKE UP LITERALLY EVERYTHING. Designed to keep tabletop surfaces looking good as new, the quality plastic design features a solid construction that protects against scratches and water ring stains. And in another scientific break through, placing your drink on a coaster will cause it to light up (batteries included). All the building blocks of fun are present in this set of glowing Radioactive Elements coasters.
